name: Underground Assault
summary: Shoni the Shilent sends Alliance adventurers into the Deadmines for a power core. The displaced gnomes need it to power drills that can break through the rock around Gnomeregan and help reclaim their home.

sections.title: A Desperate Ingenuity
sections.body: After Gnomeregan fell catastrophically to primitive troggs, surviving gnomish tinkerers fled across Khaz Modan and Stormwind. Shoni the Shilent is among the engineers already planning how to breach the rock around their lost home. Her gyrodrillmatic excavationators need great power to bore through the underground stone. Without local power grids in human lands, the gnomes have turned to goblin heavy machinery in the criminal underworld.

sections.title: Looting the Defias Foundries
sections.body: Deep in the twisting shafts of the Deadmines in Westfall, Edwin VanCleef's Defias Brotherhood employs goblin engineers to build war machines. One is a working goblin shredder, a lumbering automaton. Shoni sends Alliance operatives to destroy or dismantle it and recover its specialized heart, the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket. The exiled gnomes need the goblin power supply to drive their drills through the underground rock and begin their counteroffensive to reclaim Gnomeregan.

faq.q: Who gives the Underground Assault quest?
faq.answer: Shoni the Shilent, a gnomish engineer in Stormwind City's Dwarven District, gives it. Other gnomes often direct adventurers to her after mentioning her ambitious plans.

faq.q: Where do I find the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket?
faq.answer: You recover the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket from a working goblin shredder deep in the Deadmines foundry tunnels in Westfall.

faq.q: Why does Shoni need parts from a goblin shredder?
faq.answer: Gnomish gyrodrillmatic excavationators need immense portable power to breach the reinforced underground borders around Gnomeregan. The heavy-duty core running the Defias goblin shredder provides the exact mechanical output the drills require.

faq.q: What is the broader goal of this mission?
faq.answer: The exiled gnomes plan to power heavy excavation drills, tunnel through the rocky perimeter of captured Gnomeregan, and launch a surprise assault against the troggs occupying it.

faq.q: What happened to Gnomeregan that caused this assault to be planned?
faq.answer: A subterranean trogg invasion rose from deep beneath Gnomeregan and overwhelmed the city. Toxic radiation contaminated it during the chaotic defense, forcing survivors to flee as refugees to Ironforge and Stormwind.

faq.q: Are the Defias Brotherhood and the troggs allied?
faq.answer: No, the Defias Brotherhood and the troggs have no connection. The Defias hired goblin tinkerers to build war machines in Westfall, and Shoni exploits their Deadmines foundry as a convenient source of high-yield goblin technology.

angles.text: As an exiled gnomish adventurer, you help salvage a power core that can drive drills through the rocky walls of your fallen home and help drive the troggs from Gnomeregan.
As an engineer, you can appreciate the audacious work of cannibalizing a brutal goblin shredder's power core to fuel precise gnomish excavation machinery.
As an Alliance adventurer, you strengthen Stormwind's bond with its displaced gnomish allies and strike at the Defias supply line.
